'''Noa Essengue''' (born 18 December 2006; {{IPA|fr|nɔɑ əsɛnɡe}})<ref>{{cite AV media |publisher=Skweek | title=Noa Essengue: A dream in the making |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a61WzIk6-Ok |date=16 November 2024 |time=00:00:30 |via=YouTube}}</ref><ref>{{cite AV media |publisher=Goatoguy | title=Get to know - Noa Essengue |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ox3a-9friY0 |date=5 April 2024 |time=00:00:16 |via=YouTube}}</ref> is a French professional [[basketball]] player for the [[Chicago Bulls]] of the [[National Basketball Association]] (NBA).

==Professional career==
Essengue was born in [[Orléans]] and played for the youth teams of [[Orléans Loiret Basket]] as a child.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.larep.fr/orleans-45000/sports/noa-essengue-pepite-du-basket-originaire-d-orleans-convoque-en-equipe-de-france-a-17-ans_14581451/|title=Sports - Noa Essengue, pépite du basket originaire d'Orléans, convoqué en équipe de France à 17 ans|work=[[La République du Centre]]|date=17 October 2024|access-date=30 October 2024|language=French}}</ref> He began his professional career playing for [[Centre Fédéral de Basket-ball]], a team affiliated with [[INSEP]], in [[Nationale Masculine 1]] (NM1).<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/noa-essengue-entre-lasvel-et-ulm-noah-manet-vers-lyonso|title=Noa Essengue entre l'ASVEL et Ulm, Noah Manet vers LyonSO|first=Gabriel|last=Pantel-Jouve|website=BeBasket.fr|date=9 June 2023|access-date=30 October 2024|language=French}}</ref>

Essengue signed with [[Ratiopharm Ulm]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL) on 21 July 2023.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.bebasket.fr/le-prospect-noa-essengue-choisit-ulm-plutot-que-lasvel|title=Le prospect Noa Essengue choisit Ulm plutôt que l'ASVEL|first=Alexandre|last=Lacoste|website=BeBasket.fr|date=21 July 2023|access-date=30 October 2024|language=French}}</ref> He spent most of his first season assigned to [[OrangeAcademy]], Ulm's developmental team.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.swp.de/sport/sport-ulm-alb-donau-kreis/orange-academy-in-der-pro-b-essengue-energie-reicht-nicht_-ulmer-verlieren-ueberraschend-73212593.html|title=Essengue-Energie reicht nicht! Ulmer verlieren überraschend|first=Christian|last=Kern|work=[[Südwest Presse]]|date=3 March 2024|access-date=31 October 2024|language=German}}</ref> In the 2024–25 season, playing for coach [[Ty Harrelson]] at Ulm, Essengue became a "key contributor" for the team, according to [[FIBA]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=18 June 2025 |title=Next Big Thing: Noa Essengue continues rise of future French stars |url=https://www.fiba.basketball/en/events/fiba-eurobasket-2025/news/next-big-thing-noa-essengue-continues-rise-of-future-french-stars |access-date=27 June 2025 |website=FIBA |language=en}}</ref>

On 26 June 2025, Essengue was drafted by the [[Chicago Bulls]] with the 12th pick in the [[2025 NBA draft|NBA draft]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Chicago Bulls select Noa Essengue No. 12 overall in 2025 NBA Draft|url=https://bulls.com/news/chicago-bulls-select-noa-essengue-no-12-overall-in-2025-nba-draft |access-date=28 June 2025 |website=Chicago Bulls |language=en}}</ref> On December 3, Essengue was ruled out for the remainder of the season due to a shoulder injury that required surgery.<ref>{{Cite web |last= |first= |date=2025-12-03 |title=Chicago Bulls rookie Noa Essengue done for the season, Billy Donovan says |url=https://www.nbcchicago.com/nba/chicago-bulls/chicago-bulls-rookie-noa-essengue-done-for-the-season-billy-donovan-says/3858540/ |access-date=2025-12-04 |website=NBC Chicago |language=en-US}}</ref> He totaled just over six minutes in his rookie season, going 0-for-3 from the floor. In four games with the [[NBA G League|G-League]] [[Windy City Bulls]], Essengue averaged 23 points, 8.5 rebounds in 30.8 minutes.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2025-12-04 |title=Bulls' Essengue to have season-ending surgery |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/47195032/bulls-noa-essengue-season-ending-shoulder-surgery |access-date=2025-12-04 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref>

==National team career==
Essengue was named to the [[France men's national under-18 basketball team|France under-18 national team]] to compete in the [[2024 FIBA U18 EuroBasket]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/nba/draft/newsfeed/nba-draft-noa-essengue-ben-saraf-and-ratiopharm-ulm-s-orange-campus|title=NBA Draft: Noa Essengue, Ben Saraf, and Ratiopharm Ulm's 'Orange Campus'|first=Andrew|last=Bernucca|website=[[SI.com]]|date=20 August 2024|access-date=30 October 2024}}</ref> He was named to the [[France men's national basketball team|senior team]] for France's [[EuroBasket 2025 qualification|EuroBasket 2025 qualifier]] matches against Cyprus.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Basket/Actualites/Equipe-de-france-la-premiere-liste-de-fauthoux-avec-nolan-traore-et-noa-essengue/1514280|title=Équipe de France : la première liste de Fauthoux avec Nolan Traoré et Noa Essengue (Bleus)|work=[[L'Équipe]]|date=17 October 2024|access-date=31 October 2024|language=French}}</ref>
